statement.zh: 约尔甘特帕（努齐）1927–1931 年发掘见 Starr《努齐》报告（图版 1937；正文 1939）。努齐「早期城市」排名留假说栏。
statement.en: At Yorgan Tepa (Nuzi), the 1927–1931 excavations are documented in Starr’s Nuzi report (plates 1937; text 1939). “Early urban” rankings for Nuzi stay in the hypothesis column.
